title: Shrimp and Risotto
description: A classic Italian dish featuring shrimp and creamy risotto. Quick and flavorful, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the white wine (if using) to the skillet and cook until reduced by half.
Add the butter to the skillet and stir until melted.
Add the risotto to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of hot water to the skillet and stir until absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding water and stirring until the risotto is cooked.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted.
Return the shrimp to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
